title: The Monkey and the Wedge
moral: Do not interfere in things you do not understand.

story: Once upon a time, a group of carpenters were working near a forest. They were cutting a big log of wood and had placed a wedge in it to keep it open. At noon, they went away for lunch. Soon, a group of monkeys came there and started playing. One curious monkey climbed onto the log. He saw the wedge stuck in the wood. “What is this?” he wondered. He tried to pull it out. With great effort, he removed the wedge. Suddenly, the log closed tightly. The monkey’s tail got stuck in it! He cried out in pain. The other monkeys ran away in fear. The monkey learned a hard lesson.
